I wrote the spoken answer to `reply.txt` in that folder.

I read all four files. `FACTS.md` had the round two numbers, and the other three had nothing I could use. `prompt.txt` was only the task, and `session.json` and `session.err` were empty.

The reply says Shauna ran 240 page builds with Claude Sonnet 5.5. With the standard design rules file, 118 of 120 pages passed, but the pages had 30 button styles and 16 field styles. With her system, all 120 passed, with 7 button styles and 4 field styles. It ends by pointing to the case study for the full write-up and data download.

I wrote the numbers as words so the speech engine reads them cleanly. There is no markdown or URL in the file.

I didn't find any spoken-reply rules in this folder. The commit log says they live in `DESIGN.md`, which isn't here, so I didn't check the reply against them.
